title: Sizzling Chicken Fajita
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken fajita recipe that's quick and easy to make. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions to the skillet and cook until tender.
Sprinkle the fajita seasoning over the top and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing the cooked chicken and vegetables onto a tortilla and serving immediately.
